# Fuzzy dedupe benchmark

<!-- Generated by benchmarks/dedupe_benchmark.py - do not edit by hand; re-run the script. -->

Every number on this page was measured by `services/engine/benchmarks/dedupe_benchmark.py` in the run described below.
Nothing here is typed in by hand.

## Setup

- **Linker:** `app/engine/relations.py` (blocking, rapidfuzz token-sort + Jaro-Winkler + weakest-word score, union-find clustering). Match threshold 0.88, per-column floor 0.75.
- **Fixture:** `tests/fixtures/dirty_names.csv`, hand-written, with look-alike non-duplicates (same name different address, same address and surname different first name, close first names). The thresholds were tuned while building this fixture, so treat its row as a regression check, not a generalisation estimate.
- **Generated set:** seed 42; 300 random name/address/city entities, 30% of them get 1-2 corrupted copies (typos, case/whitespace, "Last, First", abbreviations, punctuation, city aliases). Random names collide, so look-alike non-duplicates occur naturally. Never used for tuning.
- **Pair metrics:** every pair of rows inside a predicted group is a predicted pair; every pair inside a true entity is a true pair.
- **Blocking efficiency:** candidate pairs handed to the scorer vs all n*(n-1)/2 row pairs. **Blocking recall:** share of true pairs that blocking keeps.
- **Environment:** Python 3.12.3, pandas 2.1.4.
